title: Siena no. 10: 'presura di Montepulciano', a slip deciphered at the time (ASSi Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 10, DECODE R4799)

documents.shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 10; DECODE R4799 (Concistoro_2308_53)

plaintext.source: Decipherment written letter by letter over the cipher run in a second hand: 'presura di Montepulciano'.

transcription.notes: Transcribed 18 Oct 2026 from the DECODE photograph at 2x-4x, each sign with the gloss letter over it (transcripts/no10.txt).

system.summary: Letter substitution on signs (digits, letters and invented shapes), at least two homophones each for a and o, three unglossed signs probably nulls; 16 sign values shown by the gloss.
system.notes: Only 25 signs; the gloss covers 22 of them.

prior_solution.where: The contemporary decipherment written over the cipher run on the slip itself.

conditions.human_role: None beyond filing: Daniel Bourdeau's goal to work through the Siena fascicle; George Lasry's report lists the piece under interlinear plaintext.

solution.what: Project survey (siena1421): the slip identified as one cipher run glossed 'presura di Montepulciano', read at the time; not transcribed.
25 cipher signs transcribed from the DECODE photograph with the gloss letter over each (transcripts/no10.txt).
Gloss checked against the signs: 22 signs carry a letter, every repeated sign (S, 3, 7, 1, 9, L) the same letter; a and o have two signs each; three signs carry none (nulls?).

validation.notes: 25 signs; the reading is the contemporary gloss

outcome.method_basis: The decipherment is written letter by letter over the only cipher run; the work was transcribing the signs and checking the gloss.
outcome.fraction_read_source: transcripts/no10.txt: 22 of 25 signs glossed with a letter, giving 'presura di Montepulciano' whole; the 3 unglossed signs read as nulls (grade I).

credits.note: the decipherment written over the cipher run on the slip

outcome.notes: Read at the time; transcribed and aligned here. George Lasry's report has 'pressura'; the gloss has one s.
